claim: A circulating set of claims, framed around imagery of a horned Baal/Moloch deity, asserts a series of specific things about what the released Epstein documents contain. Tested against this site's local mirror of the DOJ Epstein-files release (4,333 documents, indexed at /efta/), the central claims fail verification: (1) Whole-word "Baal" returns five hits — all of which are optical-character-recognition artifacts from low-quality Deutsche Bank statement scans (the OCR engine read "Total NSF return item" and "Legal name, first" as "Baal"). No human-authored reference to Baal, Moloch, or child-sacrifice deity-worship appears in the corpus. (2) The claim that "Israel is mentioned twice as much as Donald Trump in the new documents" is inverted: in the corpus, word-boundary case-insensitive counts give Trump 1,187 mentions across 376 documents versus Israel + Israeli 412 mentions across ~120 documents — Trump is mentioned roughly 2.9× MORE often than Israel, the opposite of the asserted claim. (3) A "Jews create vast fortunes by manipulating markets… let the goyim deal in the real world" quote is attributed to a conversation between Jeffrey Epstein and Roger Schank, characterized as a "Jewish American academic and hedge fund worker." Schank is a real Epstein correspondent, but he was an artificial-intelligence and education researcher (founder of Engines for Education), not a hedge-fund worker. The quoted line is genuine and was missed on the first pass: this site's published /efta/ cache holds 4,333 documents, and the email sits in the full 1,051,599-document release at Data Set 9, Bates EFTA00771953, with further copies at EFTA00885615 and EFTA00741068. Epstein wrote to Schank on October 23, 2009: "This is the way the jew make money.. and made a fortune in the past ten years,, selling short the shippping futures,, let the goyim deal in the real world." The Schank correspondence held in the published cache (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_030483, _030484, _029901, EFTA01788342) is about Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation education-grant policy and teacher pay, which is what the original search saw and why it drew the wrong conclusion. (4) The asserted Rothschild–Ukraine "overthrow" conversation and $25-million-for-algorithms payment do not appear in the corpus: zero documents contain both "Rothschild" and any "Ukrain*" form. (5) Searches for "Larry Fink," "Joshua Fink," "Joshua Finkelstein," "100% Jewish," "Hire Jews," "genetically Jewish," and "child sacrifice" return zero matches. The corpus's only "Svetlana" hit is a Commerzbank account holder named in a Deutsche Bank wire-transfer schedule, unrelated to the asserted BlackRock-son narrative. (6) The corpus's single "Jewish supremacy" hit (EFTA01652796) is a 2025 forwarded external email circulating a Medium opinion piece by Rima Najjar — not a finding in Epstein's own files.

notes: This record exists to publish a viral-claim-vs-record verification — the editorial premise of 2pizzaclub.com. The reel's specific named individuals who DO appear in the corpus appear in DIFFERENT contexts than the reel claims: Schank correspondence is about education, Svetlana is a banking account holder, Maria Farmer is named in a third-party tip-style document (EFTA01652971) rather than testimony. The reel's central deity-worship/child-sacrifice framing and its quantitative Israel-vs-Trump claim both fail against the actual documents. The corpus is the published DOJ release; the reel's claims are not. Local search methodology: case-insensitive word-boundary regex against the `text` field of each document JSON under efta/docs/. Counts on 2026-05-22. CORRECTION (2026-08-18): point (3) originally reported that the quoted goyim line did not appear in the Schank correspondence. That was wrong, and wrong for a specific and repeatable reason — the search ran against the published /efta/ subset (4,333 docs) instead of ~/data/epstein-files/work/corpus.jsonl (1,051,599 docs), where the email is present in three copies. Same failure mode as the Ronald Lauder record. The claim text and sources now carry the verbatim; full record at 2009-epstein-schank-goyim-email-001. The other five points were re-checked and stand.
